title: The Crystal of Courage
moral: True strength comes from courage, wisdom, and unity.

scenes.summary: Cedric is given a dangerous quest.
scenes.text: Sir Cedric is chosen by the king to find the Crystal of Valor to protect the kingdom.
scenes.image_prompt: young knight receiving quest from king in castle hall, bright cartoon style

scenes.text: Enemies threaten the kingdom, and Cedric must retrieve the crystal before it is too late.
scenes.image_prompt: dark army approaching castle, worried knights preparing

scenes.text: Guided by a mysterious map, Cedric travels through forests solving riddles.
scenes.image_prompt: knight riding horse through magical forest with glowing map

scenes.summary: Cedric solves the riddle and gets the crystal.
scenes.text: Cedric solves a riddle using wisdom and retrieves the Crystal of Valor.
scenes.image_prompt: knight holding glowing crystal in forest clearing

scenes.text: Cedric returns and inspires the knights to unite and defend the kingdom.
scenes.image_prompt: knight raising crystal while soldiers cheer at castle

story: Sir Cedric is chosen to find a magical crystal to save his kingdom. He travels through forests, solves riddles, and defeats enemies. With courage and wisdom, he returns and unites his people to defend their home.
